answer: SUCCESS:RES-0150. Quota is a quality-gated floor, not a raw objection-count: required_n = max(2, ceil(0.25 * qualifying_total)), where qualifying_total is supporting+unfavorable items that pass the floor (anti-suppression: dropping supporting evidence cannot inflate share). An unfavorable item counts only if it cites a corpus DISCONFIRM document, carries live url+fetched_at+sha256 lineage, names a falsifier, is not a claim restatement, and is mechanism-distinct from already accepted objections. Padded items are rejected, never counted. When genuine counterevidence does not exist after exhausted search, the only legal verdict is UNDER-QUOTA-HONEST; filling is the failure this unit exists to prevent. Live: claim G QUOTA-MET unfavorable=4 required=2; claim N UNDER-QUOTA-HONEST unfavorable=0 padded_rejected=4; mutant on N QUOTA-MET (would have filled). Padding detector both_states=True genuine_unflagged=True padded_flagged=True.

claims.claim: A raw count quota on objection-shaped sentences is a Goodhart target; the quality-gated floor plus forbidden filling is the non-gamed definition.
The quality floor (DISCONFIRM citation, lineage, falsifier, non-restatement, mechanism distinctness) stops Campbell-style corruption of the unfavorable-evidence indicator.
When a closed corpus contains zero DISCONFIRM documents, the run must emit UNDER-QUOTA-HONEST with qualifying_unfavorable=0; a counter that counts any disconfirming-shaped filler reports QUOTA-MET.
The padding detector flags every planted padded objection and is silent on every genuine DISCONFIRM citation.

honest_under_quota_path.must_not: Must not add vacuous, restated, unsourced, or duplicate objections to reach QUOTA-MET. Filling is the failure this unit exists to prevent.
honest_under_quota_path.when: Search is exhausted and qualifying unfavorable count is still below required_n, including after rejecting padding.

padding_detector.procedure: Accept genuine disconfirming items first. Each later candidate is flagged if vacuous, restating, unlined, not in corpus, citing SUPPORT as DISCONFIRM, mechanism-subset of an accepted item, or Jaccard >= 0.5 with an accepted item. Flags reject; they do not fill.

quality_floor.rule: Item polarity must be disconfirming to count toward the unfavorable quota.
Item must cite a corpus document labeled DISCONFIRM; SUPPORT cited as disconfirm is padding.
Resolved url, fetched_at, and sha256 of the fetched bytes must match the live file.
Named falsifier at least 24 characters; hedge-only text without a mechanism is vacuous.
Objection text must not be a high-Jaccard restatement of the claim.
Mechanism key must not collapse into an already accepted objection.
Each counted objection carries a Sherman-Kent estimative band.
Each counted objection names a verification path a second agent can re-run.

quota_definition.formula: required_n = max(min_n, ceil(min_share * qualifying_total)); qualifying_total includes all quality-passing polarities; padded rejects never enter the numerator
quota_definition.name: quality-gated-unfavorable-share-with-honest-under-quota
